svg.title: Positive predictive value rises with prevalence for a test with 90% sensitivity
svg.desc: Line plot of positive predictive value against prevalence from 0% to 20%. With 95% specificity, PPV is about 15% at 1% prevalence, 49% at 5% and 67% at 10%. With 99% specificity, PPV is about 48% at 1% prevalence.
